ash: Quick sync: launching a compact co-marketing push with NimbusCloud. Scope: marketplace listing, 30m joint webinar, short benchmark blog + replay landing. Goal = 150 qualified signups + 5 pilot leads. Can we run a 2-week sprint? @mina @owen

mina: 2 weeks ok if assets locked in 5 days. propose webinar: 30m (18m talk, 7m demo, 5m q&a). recorded demo snippet inside.

owen: i'll take blog structure + benchmark table. need model spec from eng-ml and prompt set by EOD Thu. will anonymize results.

tara: routing: registrants -> HubSpot list "nimbus_marketplace" -> add utm params utm_source=nimbus&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=nimbus_launch_apr. set "pilot_interest" checkbox. also recommend 2 subject lines for A/B test.

ash: subject ideas: A) "See how Nimbus + Redwood speed up inference" B) "Cut inference cost with Nimbus integration". Action list: mina - webinar script + slides (due Tue), owen - blog draft (due Wed), tara - hubspot + utm (due Wed).

ops-bot: Event created: "Webinar  Nimbus + Redwood: Fast, predictable inference" Thu Apr 18 11:00 PT. Calendar invites sent.

mina: design needs: co-brand hero + 2 social tiles. tagging @design for 48h turnaround.

ash: ok team, i'll ping partner-marketing for logo approvals. keep updates here and drop drive links. :thumbsup:
